clobber.translation:
n. 衣服, (鞋匠用来掩饰皮革缝的)软膏
vt. 痛打, 击倒, 拉垮

clobbered.definition:
v strike violently and repeatedly
v beat thoroughly and conclusively in a competition or fight
clobbered.translation: v. 狠揍, （不停）猛打( clobber的过去式和过去分词 ); 彻底击败

clobbering.definition:
v strike violently and repeatedly
v beat thoroughly and conclusively in a competition or fight
clobbering.translation: v. 狠揍, （不停）猛打( clobber的现在分词 ); 彻底击败
